title: 加班可以折抵壽命
premise: 員工以為加班能換休假，卻發現公司把生命算進工時。
ending: 人資宣布連投胎前等待的時間都算待命。
setting: 深夜辦公室，員工與人資站在打卡機旁。

characters.name: 阿哲
characters.description: Taiwanese man age 28, short black hair, white shirt, loose navy tie, tired eyes.

characters.name: 人資
characters.description: Taiwanese woman age 35, black bob hair, beige blazer, calm professional expression.

scenes: Midnight office entrance, both coworkers by the time clock, cool fluorescent lights, cinematic medium shot.
Same coworkers and clothes beside a desk covered in timesheets, dramatic side lighting, close reaction framing.
Same office exit, the employee holds a blank paper while the HR officer blocks the door, dry comedic tension.

shots.speaker: 阿哲
shots.text: 加班一百小時，終於可以換休假了！
shots.visual_prompt: The tired man smiles at the time clock, hopeful close-up.

shots.speaker: 人資
shots.text: 可以，我們現在都用壽命來結算。
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of the blank timesheet and HR hand.

shots.speaker: 阿哲
shots.text: 所以我多加班，就能活得久一點？
shots.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder reaction, the man turns toward HR.

shots.speaker: 人資
shots.text: 是你的剩餘壽命，可以折抵加班。
shots.visual_prompt: HR calmly taps a calculator, face not speaking on screen.

shots.speaker: 阿哲
shots.text: 等等，我不是來公司延長工時的！
shots.visual_prompt: The man's hand freezes above a stack of papers.

shots.speaker: 人資
shots.text: 放心，公司也有完整的退休制度。
shots.visual_prompt: HR points toward a closed office door.

shots.speaker: 阿哲
shots.text: 太好了，那我到底什麼時候能退休？
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of the man, relief gives way to suspicion.

shots.speaker: 人資
shots.text: 等你的壽命加班額度全部用完。
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of a clock, its hands cast a long shadow.

shots.speaker: 阿哲
shots.text: 那不就是做到死，還不能下班？
shots.visual_prompt: The man seen from behind reaches for the exit.

shots.speaker: 人資
shots.text: 沒有喔，死亡之後會轉成約聘。
shots.visual_prompt: HR places another blank contract beside his hand.

shots.speaker: 阿哲
shots.text: 我直接去投胎，總不用回公司吧？
shots.visual_prompt: A close-up of the man's trembling hand on the doorknob.

shots.speaker: 人資
shots.text: 可以，等投胎的時間記得填待命。
shots.visual_prompt: HR calmly delivers the final line, deadpan close-up.
